description:
• About our brand and products:At Plant & Plot, our mission is to empower everyone - from urban dwellers to rural homesteaders - to cultivate their own piece of paradise. We specialize in premium, high-quality raised garden beds designed to be as beautiful as they are functional. Our product lineup includes versatile 9-in-1 modular beds, oval beds (ranging from 4ft to 8ft), and specialized shapes that fit any outdoor aesthetic. Whether our customers are growing fresh organic produce or vibrant flowers, we provide the foundation for a sustainable, healthy lifestyle.

• What makes us different: We stand out in the gardening market by focusing on three core pillars:

  • Durability: Our beds are constructed from prime, long-lasting materials (galvanized steel) designed to resist rust and withstand the elements for years.

  • Ease of Use: Featuring tool-free, patented assembly, our garden beds can be set up in minutes, making gardening accessible to beginners and pros alike.

  • Sustainability: We are committed to eco-friendly practices. Our products encourage sustainable "grow-your-own" habits and are built to be a permanent fixture in the garden, reducing waste from flimsy plastic alternatives.

  • Customer-First Perks: We offer Free and Fast Delivery on EVERY order, removing a major barrier to purchase for your audience.

• How affiliates can earn: By joining the Plant & Plot family, you can turn your passion for gardening, home decor, or sustainability into a steady revenue stream.

  • Competitive Commission: Earn a percentage on every sale generated through your unique link (excluding returns).

  • High Average Order Value: Garden beds are a significant investment, meaning higher payouts per conversion for you.

  • Real-Time Tracking: Access your UpPromote dashboard to track clicks, conversions, and commissions in real-time. 

• How to promote us:We look for partners who love nature and home improvement as much as we do. Great ways to promote us include:

  • Social Media: Share "Unboxing" or "Assembly" videos on TikTok, Reels, or YouTube to show how easy our tool-free setup is.

  • Garden Blogs: Write reviews, "How-to-start a garden" guides, or "Best Raised Beds of 2024" listicles.

  • Email Newsletters: Feature our seasonal sales or "Garden Bed of the Month" to your subscribers.

  • Pinterest: Create beautiful "Garden Inspo" boards featuring our sleek, modern metal beds.

Welcome to the Plant & Plot Affiliate Program ("Program"). By signing up as an affiliate ("Affiliate") in the Program, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

1. Enrollment in the Program

1.1 To enroll in the Program, you must submit a completed application via our website.
1.2 We reserve the right to accept or reject any application at our sole discretion for any reason. You will have no legal recourse against us for rejection.

2. Affiliate Responsibilities

2.1 As an Affiliate, you agree to promote Plant & Plot products in a lawful and ethical manner.
2.2 You will only use approved marketing materials provided by Plant & Plot and will not modify them without prior consent.
2.3 Affiliates are prohibited from engaging in the following activities:

  • Misrepresentation of Plant & Plot products or services.

  • Use of spam or unsolicited email to promote Plant & Plot.

  • Bidding on Plant & Plot branded keywords in pay-per-click (PPC) campaigns without prior approval.

  • Any illegal, misleading, or fraudulent activity.

2.4 Affiliates may advertise Plant & Plot products on online platforms (e.g., Facebook, Instagram, blogs) and offline media (e.g., classified ads, magazines, newspapers). Affiliates must comply with applicable advertising standards and seek prior approval for new channels not explicitly listed.
2.5 You are responsible for ensuring that your participation in the Program complies with all laws, including FTC disclosure guidelines and any applicable tax obligations.
2.6 Participation in the Program is subject to a fair use policy. Plant & Plot reserves the right to review all referred transactions to ensure compliance with these terms and ethical conduct.

3. Commission Structure

3.1 Affiliates will earn a commission of up to 10% of the net sale value for each valid sale generated through their unique referral link.
3.2 Commissions will only be paid for sales that are:

  • Successfully completed (e.g., not refunded, canceled, or charged back).

  • Tracked through our affiliate tracking system.

3.3 Plant & Plot reserves the right to adjust commission rates and payment terms with prior notice.

4. Payment Terms

4.1 Commissions are paid on a monthly basis, provided the Affiliate’s balance has reached the minimum payout threshold of $500.
4.2 Payments will be made via PayPal or direct deposit.
4.3 Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information. Plant & Plot is not responsible for delays or issues caused by incorrect information.
4.4 Any unpaid balances below the payout threshold will roll over to the next payment period.
4.5 Affiliates can view commission status, pending transactions, and completed payments in the Affiliate Dashboard.
4.6 Transactions resulting in chargebacks or refunds will not qualify for commissions.

5. Affiliate Links, Coupons, and Cookies

5.1 Affiliate links are automatically generated but can also be created for specific products or collections.
5.2 If a customer clicks on multiple affiliate links, the commission will be attributed to the last click.
5.3 If both an affiliate link and a coupon code are used, commissions will not be doubled.
5.4 Affiliates may only use coupon codes assigned to them. Promotion of unapproved coupons is prohibited.
5.5 The Program uses cookies to track referrals. The cookie duration is 14 days, meaning that you will earn a commission on any valid sale made within this time frame from a customer who clicked your referral link.
5.6 If a user disables or clears their browser cookies, tracking may fail, and commissions may not be attributed. Plant & Plot is not liable for untracked referrals due to cookie limitations.

6. Marketing Tools

6.1 Plant & Plot may provide promotional media, including banners, logos, and specific collection promotions, through the Affiliate Dashboard.
6.2 Affiliates may download and use these materials for promotion. HTML embed codes may also be shared for affiliate platforms.
6.3 Affiliates are prohibited from modifying promotional media without prior approval.

7. Intellectual Property and Content Usage

7.1 Affiliates are granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use Plant & Plot trademarks, logos, and marketing materials solely for the purpose of promoting Plant & Plot products.
7.2 Affiliates must cease use of all intellectual property upon termination of this agreement.
7.3 By participating in the Program, Affiliates grant Plant & Plot a royalty-free, perpetual, worldwide license to use any content created by the Affiliate related to Plant & Plot products (e.g., images, videos, social media posts, testimonials) for marketing, advertising, and promotional purposes. This includes but is not limited to, use on the Plant & Plot website, social media platforms, email campaigns, and other advertising channels.
7.4 Plant & Plot agrees to credit the Affiliate where reasonable and appropriate but reserves the right to use the content at its discretion without additional compensation or approval from the Affiliate.

8. Limitation of Liability

8.1 Plant & Plot will not be liable for any indirect, special, or consequential damages arising in connection with the Program.
8.2 Plant & Plot makes no express or implied warranties or representations with respect to the Program or Affiliate’s potential to earn income.
8.3 Plant & Plot is not responsible for technical issues, such as tracking errors due to disabled cookies or system malfunctions, that may prevent proper attribution of commissions.

9. Termination

9.1 Either party may terminate this agreement at any time, with or without cause, by providing written notice to the other party.
9.2 Affiliates wishing to voluntarily leave the Program may request removal by contacting info@plantandplot.com.
9.3 Plant & Plot reserves the right to terminate any Affiliate who violates these terms or engages in activities that may harm the brand’s reputation.
9.4 Upon termination, the Affiliate will no longer receive commissions for sales generated after the termination date.

10. Modification of Terms

10.1 Plant & Plot reserves the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of changes via email or through the Affiliate Dashboard.
10.2 Continued participation in the Program after any modifications constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

11. Governing Law

11.1 This agreement will be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the United States.

12. Entire Agreement

12.1 This agreement constitutes the entire agreement between Plant & Plot and the Affiliate with respect to the Program and supersedes all prior agreements.

We’re thrilled to have you as part of the Plant & Plot Affiliate Program. If you have any questions, contact us at info@plantandplot.com. Let’s grow together!
